# Pot

![Pot](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/pot.png)

Heads: points equal to the flips made so far this level (max 12).

- **Rarity:** Uncommon
- **Heads chance:** 50%
- **Shop price:** 15 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Nothing

## Tails
Score 1 point

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Blade](characters-blade)
